Kept at WORKSPACE scope (here) rather than in the devcontainer's customizations, because the MSSQL extension reads connection profiles from workspace/user settings — dev-container customizations land in machine-scoped settings, where the profile does not surface (see vscode-mssql#17500). Students click-to-connect: open the SQL Server view or a .sql file and pick 'AIDD-MS Lab (AdventureWorksLT)'.
